BiblicalUsage: yôwmâm means daily. In Exodus 13:21 we read, "And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire..." It appears again in Leviticus 8:35: "Therefore shall ye abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days..."
TheologicalSignificance: yowmam is daily, and I believe God put it in his book for a reason, so I want to hear what it says.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
